title: On Sinking to the bottom of the pool
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：sink　|　正文 359 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sink 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the stone ① sank to the bottom of the pool twice over, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the stone ② sinks to the bottom of the pool year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ sink to the bottom of the pool at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ sunk to the bottom of the pool before — a line in the plan for October 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sinking to the bottom of the pool twice over, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the stone ever ⑥ sinks into the mud past the axle year after year before the October rains, nobody in the site would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ sink into the mud past the axle year after year and never speak of it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a second stone ⑧ sinks into the mud past the axle twice over every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the site said a word; ⑨ The stone sank to the bottom of the pool again in 1983, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To sink to the bottom of the pool, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, the stone sinks to the bottom of the pool year after year again and the stone must sink to the bottom of the pool twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 沉没（一般过去式 sank to the bottom of the pool：1973 年那块石头头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 沉没（一般现在 sinks to the bottom of the pool：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 沉没（不定式 to sink to the bottom of the pool：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 沉没（过去完成时 had sunk to the bottom of the pool：1967 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 沉没（动名词 sinking to the bottom of the pool 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 下陷（sinks into the mud past the axle：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真下陷陷进泥里直到车轴）
G. v. 下陷（sink into the mud past the axle：let it 之后的原形，指随它去陷进泥里直到车轴）
H. v. 沉没（后段两处：后来的那块石头照例 sinks into the mud past the axle，而那块石头在 1983 年又一次 sank to the bottom of the pool）

answers.why: sink 意为“沉没”，1973 年那块石头来回两遍沉没沉到池底，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 sank。
sink 意为“沉没”，自那以后那块石头年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sinks。
sink 意为“沉没”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯沉没沉到池底”，此处为不定式 to sink to the bottom of the pool。
sink 意为“沉没”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人沉没过，故用过去完成时 had sunk。
sink 意为“沉没”，那块石头说“沉没沉到池底这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 sinking to the bottom of the pool 作主语。
sink 意为“下陷”，叔叔说的是“万一那块石头真下陷陷进泥里直到车轴”，if 从句里用一般现在 sinks into the mud past the axle。
sink 意为“下陷”，老手们的规矩是“随它下陷陷进泥里直到车轴”（let it sink into the mud past the axle），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
sink 意为“沉没”，后来的那块石头每个月份都照例下陷陷进泥里直到车轴，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sinks。
sink 意为“沉没”，那块石头在 1983 年在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍沉没沉到池底，用一般过去式 sank 叙述。
sink 意为“沉没”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要沉没沉到池底，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年，那块石头来回两遍沉没沉到池底；工地里每一个帮工都说这是头一回。（sank to the bottom of the pool）
多年以后，那块石头仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（sinks to the bottom of the pool）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯沉没沉到池底这件事本身。（to sink to the bottom of the pool）
早在 1967 年就有人沉没沉到池底，十月那天施工图上的一行字就是证据。（had sunk to the bottom of the pool）
那块石头说过，来回两遍沉没沉到池底这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（sinking to the bottom of the pool 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它下陷陷进泥里直到车轴，以后再也不要提起。（let it sink into the mud past the axle）
answers: In 1973 the stone sank to the bottom of the pool twice over, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the stone still sinks to the bottom of the pool year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to sink to the bottom of the pool at all was the part nobody had expected.
The stone had sunk to the bottom of the pool long before 1980, and the line in the plan for October proves it.
Sinking to the bottom of the pool twice over, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: let it sink into the mud past the axle year after year and never speak of it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sink 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the stone sank to the bottom of the pool twice over, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the stone sinks to the bottom of the pool year after year whenever the site asks.
Sinking to the bottom of the pool twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the stone ever sinks into the mud past the axle year after year before the October rains, nobody knows what to do next.
A second stone sinks into the mud past the axle twice over every month, asking nothing about the past.
The stone sank to the bottom of the pool again in 1983, and this time nothing was written down.
